==Description==
The '''Golden Body Guards 1''' was a [[Units|unit]] spawned by the [[Golden Crook Boss]] at Level 3. In the game, the '''Golden Body Guards 1''' was referred to as just '''Body Guards''', though it has been referenced here as '''Golden Body Guards 1''' to differentiate itself from other [[Crook Boss]] and [[Golden Crook Boss]] units. As with other [[units]], it started from the end of the map path and moved towards the entrance of the map.

Whenever there was an enemy in its range, the '''Golden Body Guards 1''' would stop moving to shoot at the enemies. It would continue walking when there were no enemies left in its range. The '''Golden Body Guards 1''' had a spawnrate of 40 seconds.

There was a limit of two units per [[Golden Crook Boss]] at Level 3, limiting the amount of '''Golden Body Guards 1s''' it could spawn.

==Appearance==
The '''Golden Body Guards 1''' were made up of two humanoids that were nearly identical to each other. They had pale skin, black pants, brown cotton gloves, a black buttoned tuxedo with a golden shirt underneath and grey shoes. One of them also wore a blue necktie, while the other a red necktie, and were faceless. One of them also had a yellow briefcase on its back. The '''Golden Body Guards 1''' wield a [[wp:Luger pistol|Luger P08]] in their right hands.

==Strategy==
*You should not rely too much on the '''Golden Body Guards 1''' because of its slow spawnrate.
*You will need to wait 40 seconds for a '''Golden Body Guards 1''' to spawn if you place down a [[Crook Boss]] and immediately upgrade it to Level 3.
*The '''Golden Body Guards 1''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with [[defense]], like the [[Giant Boss]].
**However, the '''Golden Body Guards 1's''' ranged damage is still affected by enemies with [[defense]].
*The '''Golden Body Guards 1''' cannot detect [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] and [[Flying]] enemies, but they can still be damaged when the '''Golden Body Guards 1''' collides with them. However, this is likely unfavorable as the '''Golden Body Guards 1's''' damage comes primarily from firing at enemies rather than collision.
**The [[Ace Pilot]] cannot give the '''Golden Body Guards 1''' hidden detection.
**The '''Golden Body Guards 1''' cannot collide with ghost enemies, like the [[Soul]].
*On maps with multiple paths, only one '''Golden Body Guards 1''' will spawn per Level 3 [[Golden Crook Boss]].
**The '''Golden Body Guards 1''' will go down a random path.
*The '''Golden Body Guards 1''' will struggle against fast enemies, like the [[Shock]] or [[Glitch]], as they can run into the '''GoldenBody Guard 2''' without taking much damage.
*The '''Golden Body Guards 1''' is not affected by any buff or debuff.
*The '''Golden Body Guards 1''' will struggle against any enemy with abilities that damage units, because of its low health.
**For example, if the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] uses its ''Stomp'' attack, and a '''Golden Body Guards 1''' is caught in the attack, it is instantly killed.
